language.label: Language
language.help: UI language. "Auto (system)" follows your OS language; model replies follow this setting as well.

general.title: General
general.mermaidHelp: When on, mermaid code fences (flowchart / sequence / state / ER …) in answers render as diagrams you can copy as an image, download as SVG or open full size. When off, the source is always shown. Rendering is display-only — the session always stores the original source.
general.privileged: Privileged Mode (skip all permission confirmations, allow any command)
general.privilegedHelp: When on, the Agent can call any tool without asking and the permission policy cannot block it (including Bash/Write and other dangerous operations). On by default; when off, asks / blocks per the permission policy. Note: your PreToolUse hooks still run (hooks are custom rules and always apply).
general.privilegedOn: Privileged Mode on: all tools run directly without asking
general.privilegedOff: Privileged Mode off: ask / block per the permission policy
general.rtkLabel: rtk output compression (when rtk CLI is installed)
general.rtkHelp: When on and rtk is installed, whitelisted commands (git status/diff/log, pytest, cargo build/test, go test, kubectl get/pods, gh pr, grep, ls, tree, npm/pnpm test, docker ps) are rewritten as "rtk <cmd>" to compress terminal output and save tokens. Compound commands (pipes / && / redirects) are never rewritten. Turning it off makes every command run as-is.
general.rtkOn: rtk compression on: whitelisted commands run via rtk
general.rtkOff: rtk compression off: all commands run as-is
general.subHint: Allowed 1-16, default 5; takes effect right after saving
general.subHelp: Hard cap on subagents running concurrently under the same parent session; requests over the cap are rejected with a list of the currently running ones.
general.logHelp: Runtime logs (~/.ginno/logs/) older than this are deleted automatically; swept at startup and once a day.
general.logClamped: Out of range, clamped to {n} (0-90 allowed)
general.lastwordsHelp: Recover interrupted sessions after a dev-swap restart: notify injects a restore note (default); auto resumes the turn (explicit dev-swap only); off disables recovery

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Read-only self-check of data integrity, scheduled tasks, the runtime, and API contracts. Nothing is modified.

runtime.stale_bundle: Runtime binary was replaced after startup

diagnostics.fixEqualsConfirm: Append "unsetopt EQUALS" to ~/.zshenv to stop =xx errors in non-interactive zsh. Proceed?
